claims.statement: Project for a monumental bronze equestrian statue of Francesco Sforza. A full scale clay model was shown in November 1493 and damaged in 1499. The bronze was never cast.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Court correspondence; Leonardo's notes and drawings.
